> AGENT

Yes, you’re hitting diminishing returns.

What I’m seeing is:
- The reviewer is still finding some real issues, but the hit rate has dropped.
- A growing share of the comments are stale or are re-reporting bugs that are already fixed in the current tree.
- We’re spending more time verifying reviewer drift than fixing new defects.

That usually means the review loop is no longer the highest-leverage tool for this patch set. The value now is probably:
- Catching one last real race or contract bug if it exists.
- Converting the real classes of bugs you already found into regression tests.
- Stopping once consecutive review runs are mostly stale/noisy.

My recommendation:
- Do not keep running reviews indefinitely on the same patch stack.
- Run at most one more review pass after the latest fixes.
- If that pass is mostly stale again, stop and shift to targeted regression tests plus a normal final sanity pass.

The practical bar I’d use:
- If the next review has 0-1 real findings and the rest are stale, you’re done.
- If it finds another truly new P1/P2, fix it and run one final confirmation pass.
- If repeated runs keep surfacing the same already-fixed themes, the reviewer has started to lag the code and you should stop trusting iterative reruns as the main signal.

So: yes, you are starting to go in circles. One final pass is reasonable; beyond that, it’s probably wasted time unless the next run surfaces a clearly new bug.

async function loadLatestReviewUnlessManuallyFailed(env: Env, reviewId: string): Promise<ReviewRunResponse | null> {

function startManualFailAbortMonitor(env: Env, reviewId: string): { signal: AbortSignal; stop: () => void } {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  let stopped = false;
  let polling = false;
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

  const stop = (): void => {
    if (stopped) {
      return;
    }
    stopped = true;
    if (timer !== null) {
      clearInterval(timer);
      timer = null;
    }
  };

  const poll = async (): Promise<void> => {
    if (stopped || polling || controller.signal.aborted) {
      return;
    }
    polling = true;
    try {
      const latest = await getReviewRun(env.DB, reviewId);
      if (isManuallyFailedReview(latest)) {
        controller.abort();
        stop();
      }
    } finally {
      polling = false;
    }
  };

  timer = setInterval(() => {
    void poll();
  }, 250);
  void poll();

  return { signal: controller.signal, stop };
}

/**
 * Claims, executes, persists, and finalizes one review run.
 * This is the main orchestration boundary for review execution and retry scheduling.
 */
export async function processReviewRun(env: Env, reviewId: string, options?: ReviewRunExecutionOptions): Promise<void> {
  const claimed = await claimReviewRunForExecution(env.DB, reviewId);
  if (!claimed) {
    const existing = await getReviewRun(env.DB, reviewId);
    if (existing?.status === 'running') {
      await handleUnclaimedReviewRun(env, reviewId, existing, options?.allowRetryScheduling ?? true);
    }
    return;
  }

  let review: ReviewRunResponse | null = null;
  const manualFailAbortMonitor = startManualFailAbortMonitor(env, reviewId);
  try {
    review = await getReviewRun(env.DB, reviewId);
    if (!review) {
      return;
    }

    const payload = await getReviewRunRequestPayload(env.DB, reviewId);
    if (!payload) {
      await updateReviewRunStatus(env.DB, reviewId, 'failed', {
        errorCode: 'review_not_found',
        errorMessage: 'Review request payload no longer exists',
      });
      await appendReviewEvent(env.DB, {
        reviewId,
        eventType: 'review_failed',
        payload: {
          code: 'review_not_found',
          message: 'Review request payload no longer exists',
        },
      });
      return;
    }

    const reviewContext = await assembleReviewContextBootstrap(env, review, payload, options);
    const report = await executeReviewRun(env, review, payload, reviewContext, {
      ...options,
      abortSignal: manualFailAbortMonitor.signal,
    });
    const latest = await loadLatestReviewUnlessManuallyFailed(env, reviewId);
    if (!latest) {
      return;
    }
    await finalizeSuccessfulReview(env, reviewId, payload, report, {
      expectedAttemptCount: review.attemptCount,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = formatReviewAnalysisError(error, {
      openrouterApiKey=[REDACTED](options?.openrouterApiKey),
    });
    const latest = await loadLatestReviewUnlessManuallyFailed(env, reviewId);
    if (!latest) {
      return;
    }
    const attemptCount = latest?.attemptCount ?? review?.attemptCount ?? 0;

    const allowRetryScheduling = options?.allowRetryScheduling !== false;
    if (allowRetryScheduling && shouldRetryReviewError(error) && attemptCount <= 2) {
      const retryScheduled = await scheduleReviewRetryIfCurrent(env, reviewId, {
        attemptCount,
        message,
        reason: message.slice(0, 500),
      });
      if (retryScheduled) {
        throw new QueueRetryError('Review transient failure; retry requested');
      }
    }

    const contextAssemblyErrorCode = error instanceof ReviewContextAssemblyError ? error.code : null;
    const finalErrorCode = contextAssemblyErrorCode ?? 'review_execution_failed';
    await finalizeFailedReviewIfCurrent(env, reviewId, {
      errorCode: finalErrorCode,
      message,
      contextAssemblyErrorCode,
      expectedAttemptCount: attemptCount,
    });
  } finally {
    manualFailAbortMonitor.stop();
  }
}

export async function runReviewInlineWithRetries(
  env: Env,
  reviewId: string,
  maxCycles = 4,
  options?: ReviewRunExecutionOptions
): Promise<void> {
  for (let cycle = 0; cycle < maxCycles; cycle += 1) {

      return;
    }
    if (latest.error?.code !== 'retry_scheduled') {
      return;
    }
  }

- The stale-recovery success finding was stale. [`finalization.ts`](/Users/nickdejesus/Code/nimbus/packages/worker/src/lib/review-runner/finalization.ts) already allows same-attempt success to finalize from `queued` with `retry_scheduled`, fenced by `expectedAttemptCount`.
- The manual-fail retry finding was stale. [`review-runner.ts`](/Users/nickdejesus/Code/nimbus/packages/worker/src/lib/review-runner.ts) already aborts active review work and uses guarded retry/failure writes, so `review_execution_aborted` is terminal for the in-flight attempt.
- The SSE startup-abort finding was stale. [`ui-proxy.ts`](/Users/nickdejesus/Code/nimbus/packages/cli/src/app/reviews/ui-proxy.ts) no longer passes a disconnect abort signal into `startStudioNewReview()`.

- No production changes were needed. The current tree already contains all three fixes.

At this point the review loop is mostly surfacing stale findings you already fixed, and the current focused suites are passing. That is the clearest sign you’ve crossed from useful discovery into diminishing returns.

What’s left is not “keep re-reviewing.” It’s:

- optionally run one final broader sanity pass if you want extra confidence
- stop treating repeated reviewer reruns as a primary signal on this patch set

So I’d consider the review/fix cycle complete unless you specifically want one last non-review validation step, like a deploy smoke test or a broader test sweep.
